definitions.explanation: An aircraft designed to operate from a warship, especially an aircraft carrier.

examples.japanese: {艦載機|かんさいき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発進|はっしん}した→発進する：21033_hasshinsuru⟧。
⟦{空母|くうぼ}→空母：15702_kuubo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{艦載機|かんさいき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{積|つ}まれている→積む：02294_tsumu⟧。
examples.english: An aircraft carrier holds many carrier-based planes.

examples.japanese: {艦載機|かんさいき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{短|みじか}い→短い：00510_mijikai⟧⟦{滑走路|かっそうろ}→滑走路：05980_kassouro⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{離着陸|りちゃくりく}→離着陸：20749_richakuriku⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧よう⟦{設計|せっけい}→設計：03300_sekkei⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Carrier-based aircraft are designed to take off and land on short runways.

notes:
Compound of {艦|かん} (warship) and {載|さい} (to load, carry) plus ⟦{機|き}→〜機：09843_ki⟧ (aircraft) — literally "ship-loaded aircraft."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {艦載機|かんさいき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{発着|はっちゃく}→発着：06808_hacchaku⟧: takeoff and landing of carrier aircraft
- ⟦{空母|くうぼ}→空母：15702_kuubo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{艦載機|かんさいき}: an aircraft carrier's planes

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{戦闘機|せんとうき}→戦闘機：23287_sentouki⟧: fighter jet — defined by its role, not by where it is based
- ⟦{空母|くうぼ}→空母：15702_kuubo⟧: aircraft carrier — the ship that carries them
